section_summary.extract_value: This abstract describes a single cross-sectional study (Study X) examining the mediating roles of self-reassurance and body-image appreciation in the relationship between social safeness/acceptance and eating psychopathology dimensions. The study included 309 Portuguese women aged 18-50 years from the general community who completed self-report measures. The path analysis revealed significant mediation effects, with the model explaining substantial variance in restraint, eating concern, weight concern, and shape concern.
